title: What a Godly Man Does With a Raise (It's Not Upgrading Everything)
caption:
Nobody warns you that a raise is a test. The money shows up and the upgrades start: the apartment, the car, the dinners. Six months later you're just as tight as before, and a little prouder.

Thank God before you spend it. Raise your giving before your lifestyle. Keep living on last year's number for a while. And don't let a bigger paycheck tell you you're a bigger man.

"Everyone to whom much was given, of him much will be required." Luke 12:48

Save this for the day the raise hits.
